scripts.build: cd apps/web && vite build && cd ../.. && tsc -p apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/cf-bootstrap
scripts.deploy: cd apps/web && vite build && cd ../.. && tsc -p apps/api && cd apps/api && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:local: cd apps/api && wrangler d1 migrations apply 9r2-db --local
scripts.db:remote: cd apps/api && wrangler d1 migrations apply 9r2-db --remote
